text:
harper: Postmortem follow-up: need clear owners + deadlines for customer comms after todays outage. Items: short status page line, 72-hour redacted technical brief, RCA sharing policy, and a CSM-ready FAQ. Also note this is the 3rd prefix-cache pressure incident in the last month; we should call that out. Proposals: @evan status page, @mina 72h brief, @cory + legal_team RCA policy. Ack + ETA?

ev an: Ack (evan). I can take the status page copy. Draft below  please keep it customer-friendly.

ev an: ```
Status: Resolved at 02:47 UTC.
Impact: elevated latencies and intermittent errors for a subset of requests between 00:3002:47 UTC.
Cause: prefix KV cache pressure (under investigation).
Were tracking this as a recurring operational pattern and will publish a 72-hour redacted summary with remediation steps.
```

mina: Ack. Ill draft the 72h redacted brief. Quick Q: should the brief enumerate impacted components by name or keep higher-level? Legal_team, advise on redaction scope.

legal_team: Please avoid raw traces, internal hostnames, session tokens, and PII in public docs. You may list affected components (e.g., inference runtime, prefix cache) and provide timelines/milestones. Enterprise customers may request deeper artifacts via secure/account channels.

cory: Comms + CSM: +1. Proposed public RCA sentence: "A redacted RCA will be shared with all impacted customers within 72 hours. Customers with contractual access can request the full RCA through their account teams." I will draft the CSM FAQ template once policy text is finalized.

harper: Timelines: status page final by tomorrow EOD (evan), 72h redacted summary by Fri 17:00 UTC (mina), RCA policy + CSM FAQ by Fri COB (cory/legal_team). Remediation owners (please confirm): infra: alert thresholds & soft-eviction (owner: mina, ETA 10 days); runtime: KV sizing defaults review (owner: rachel, ETA 5 days); product: query-pattern analysis (owner: jules, ETA 3 weeks). Add to tracker.

harper: Summary: status page by tomorrow (evan), 72h redacted brief by Fri 17:00 UTC (mina), redacted RCA to impacted customers; full RCA via contract for enterprise. Mark items done in the tracker and flag blockers with prefix "blocker:". Thanks all.
